[[Image:NAMA Fouet votif.jpg|right|thumb|250px|''A [[bronze]] '''whip''''']]
A '''whip''' is a [[attack types|blunt]] [[weapon]] that consists of a flexible length of [[material]] that can be swung with great speed. Whips have the lowest contact area and highest velocity multiplier in the game, making them amazingly effective, even against [[armor]]ed opponents; this behavior has been reported as a [[#Bugs|bug]]. Whips are similar to [[scourge]]s, though the scourge is an edge weapon with a larger contact area.

Whips use and train the [[lasher]] skill. As foreign weapons, whips cannot be [[forge|forged]] by dwarves. However, adventurers can be made to start with masterwork whips, and low-[[quality]] specimens can be traded from human [[caravan]]s, or scavenged from invaders. [[Weapon#Size|Even the smallest dwarves]] can equip a whip one-handed.


==Bugs==
* Whips currently cut through steel armor like butter. While this is very beneficial (given that it is not being used against you), it is still a bug, and is bound to be fixed sometime. {{bug|2712}}
